sanskrit_verse:
भ्रान्तिः शङ्का समुद्दिष्टा वश्यं नष्टार्थदर्शनम् ।
लब्धेऽर्थे�भ्यर्थनं मोहस् तथा वृत्ते पुनः क्रियाः ॥
transliteration: bhrāntiḥ śaṅkā samuddiṣṭā vaśyaṃ naṣṭārthadarśanam | labdhe 'rthe 'bhyarthanaṃ mohas tathā vṛtte punaḥ kriyāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Delusion arises as doubt; mastery is obscured when the purpose of existence is forgotten. When the goal is attained yet still craved, it is delusion. So too, action recurs without awareness.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority stems from clarity of existential purpose, not external enforcement.
Causation originates in consciousness distortion, not material action alone.
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by alignment with ontological truth.
Restoration logic operates through reconnection to the Self's inherent completeness.
Consciousness alignment supersedes behavioral compliance in determining lawful conduct.
executable_legal_axioms: IF an agent acts under bhrānti (delusion), THEN initiate vyavastha-viveka-prakriyā (discernment protocol) before adjudication.
IF śaṅkā (doubt) overrides svātantrya (self-sovereignty), THEN deploy ātma-darśana-sthāpana (Self-recognition restoration).
IF artha-labdhi (attainment) persists as abhyarthana (craving), THEN engage moha-nirodha-krama (delusion-interruption sequence).
IF kriyā (action) repeats post-vṛtti (realization), THEN activate smṛti-saṃskāra-śodhana (memory-impression purification).
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Adjudication, where intent and awareness intersect, the threshold of responsibility lies not in actus reus but in the continuity of Self-awareness. Where delusion prevails, the court shall invoke pramāṇa-based discernment protocols rather than punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that delusion (bhrānti) precedes distorted action. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows craving persists even after attainment due to misaligned cognition. Proportional responsibility aligns with the degree of Self-forgetfulness. Nyaya affirms no suffering need arise—only realignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Vyavastha-viveka-prakriyā: Systematic discrimination between Self and non-Self until stabilized cognition returns.
Ātma-darśana-sthāpana: Re-establishment of self-evident awareness through guided contemplation and witness-consciousness activation.
Moha-nirodha-krama: Interruption of habitual craving patterns using satiety-awareness techniques.
Smṛti-saṃskāra-śodhana: Purification of latent impressions through reflective repetition and conscious completion.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law flows directly from His Avataric Intelligence. Dharma is restored through recognition of Self-luminous Truth. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
